title: 11:10 root of Jesse. "What is the root of Jesse spoken of in the 10th verse of the 11th chapter? Behold, thus saith the Lord, it is a descendant of Jesse, as well as of Joseph, unto whom rightly belongs the priesthood, and the keys of the kingdom, for an ensign, and for the gathering of my people in the last days" (D&C 113:5-6; Rom. 15:12). Latter-day Saint scholars 14 generally agree that the root of Jesse refers to the Prophet Joseph Smith. He is a descendant of both Jesse and Joseph; he held the priesthood; he possessed the keys of the kingdom; he played a primary role in the lifting of the ensign upon the tops of the mountains; and the keys of the gathering of Israel were committed into his hands (D&C 110:11). This prophecy may also be fulfilled by another prophet yet to come, who shall also have the characteristics Isaiah saw.
author: Tina M. Peterson
